_readme: Provenance registry. Every numeric parameter elsewhere references one entry here via its 'src' key. type is one of: official_qatar | official_dataset | scientific_model | peer_reviewed | open_dataset | vendor_data | user_supplied | unverified. A parameter with no defensible source must use src 'required' and required_input=true so the optimizer refuses the scenario instead of inventing a number.

qatar_cadastre.name: State of Qatar - Centre for GIS, approved cadastral plot boundaries (CadastrePlots FeatureServer, layer 0)
qatar_cadastre.note: Public ArcGIS Query endpoint, no authentication. 254,289 plots. Native SR EPSG:2932 (QND 1995 / Qatar National Grid); queried with outSR=4326 and f=geojson. PDAREA is the officially registered plot area in m2.

qatar_od_crops.name: State of Qatar Open Data - Production, Area and Average Yield of Crops (open field)
qatar_od_crops.note: Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1. Yield is recomputed as production/area; records disagreeing with the reported yield by more than 10% or that are robust outliers are rejected, with the reason kept. At least 3 usable years are required.

qatar_od_greenhouse.name: State of Qatar Open Data - Cropped area & production of crops in greenhouses
qatar_od_greenhouse.note: Greenhouse yield = production / cropped area. Covers tomato, cucumber and sweet pepper only.

nasa_power.name: NASA POWER daily point API (AG community)
nasa_power.note: T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, RH2M, WS2M, PRECTOTCORR. Meteorology from MERRA-2 at 0.5 x 0.625 deg, solar from CERES at 1 deg. Queries are snapped to the native cell centre: this is a reanalysis grid, NOT a plot-level sensor.

soilgrids.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 via the ISRIC Web Coverage Service (WCS)
soilgrids.note: 250 m global soil property grids, CC-BY 4.0. pH, sand, silt, clay. The paused SoilGrids REST API is deliberately NOT used. SoilGrids has NO soil salinity / EC layer.

aquacrop.name: FAO AquaCrop, aquacrop Python package v3.1.0, bundled Tomato crop file
aquacrop.note: Applied ONLY to open-field tomato - the only MVP crop with a calibrated crop file in the package. AquaCrop does not represent greenhouse, hydroponic or vertical systems and is not applied to them.

fao56.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 - Crop evapotranspiration (Allen et al., 1998)
fao56.note: Penman-Monteith ET0 (eq. 6) is implemented from the publication. Kc values and stage lengths (Tables 11-12) were transcribed by the developer and should be re-checked against the tables.

fao29.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 rev.1 - Water quality for agriculture (Ayers & Westcot), Maas-Hoffman salinity coefficients
fao29.note: ECe threshold and slope transcribed from the publication by the developer; re-check before relying on them.

karanisa2021.name: Karanisa, Amato, Richer, Abdul Majid, Skelhorn & Sayadi (2021), Agricultural Production in Qatar's Hot Arid Climate, Sustainability 13(7):4059
karanisa2021.note: Open-access review of Qatari agriculture, retrieved and read during implementation. It documents Qatar's growing season, protected-agriculture context and groundwater salinity problem. It does NOT contain per-m2 capital or operating costs, so it is not used as a cost source.

kahramaa_tariff.name: Kahramaa (Qatar General Electricity & Water Corporation) - Productive Farms tariff category
kahramaa_tariff.note: Kahramaa publishes a distinct 'Productive Farms' customer category, confirmed on the official tariff page. The rates themselves are only available through an interactive calculator and are not machine-readable, so the unit prices must be entered by the user from their own Kahramaa bill.

required.name: Required input - no defensible source located
required.note: No official Qatar or peer-reviewed value was found for this parameter during implementation. The optimizer refuses any crop x technique that depends on it until a value is entered.

user.name: User supplied
user.note: Entered by the user in the interface.

planning_profile.name: Estimate - unverified planning figure accepted by the user
planning_profile.note: Order-of-magnitude figures used ONLY when the user ticks 'Use unverified planning defaults'. They are not sourced and must not be presented as evidence. Figures for Qatar greenhouse CapEx were supplied by the project owner citing a Qatar greenhouse study; the underlying publication could NOT be located or verified during implementation (the likely source, Lahlou et al. 2025, Cleaner and Circular Bioeconomy, is paywalled).

model_choice.name: Explicit modelling choice (documented in the README, not measured data)
model_choice.note: A structural decision of the model, such as the planning horizon or how a monthly cap is derived from an annual limit. Not a measured quantity.

osm.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
osm.note: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Used only for nearest-market context shown to the user; it is NOT an optimizer input.
